title: Natural bounded-below condensed pushforward hypercover comparison
statement: Let Lambda be a condensed commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], f:X to Y a morphism, q an integer and V an affine weakly contractible pro-etale Y-object. Let U be an affine weakly contractible hypercover of W=X times_Y V. On strictly bounded-below complexes of internal Lambda_X-modules there is a natural isomorphism between evaluation at V of degree-q cohomology of the specified derived pushforward [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] and degree-q homology of the underlying abelian hypercover total [def-weil-pbc-proetale-abelian-hypercover-total].

source.place: Tags 09A2 and 0946; Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach, Constructible sheaves, Lemma 5.3(1)

proof.text: Exact evaluation at V gives a natural transformation from ordinary section-complex homology to evaluated derived pushforward cohomology, using the derived functor unit and the defining pushforward section formula. It is invertible on K-injectives.

Choose bounded-below termwise-injective resolutions. Their section augmentations are quasi-isomorphisms by injective-row descent and bounded-below row comparison. The total also inverts bounded-below coefficient quasi-isomorphisms.

Compose the resulting four isomorphisms on homology. For a coefficient map, lift it to the K-injective resolutions up to homotopy. The reused bounded-below homotopy-invariance theorem shows that any functor inverting the relevant quasi-isomorphisms identifies homotopic maps. Naturality of the derived unit and augmentation, followed by cancellation of the resolution maps, proves naturality of the assembled comparison.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09A2 and 0946; Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach, Lemma 5.3(1); G2 explicit abelian-section construction, reusing map_eq_of_boundedBelow_homotopy at its original source module

theorem condensedHypercover_comparison
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (q : ℤ) (V : Y.ProEt) (hVaff : IsAffine V.left)
    (hV : ∀ (F G : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (Type (u + 1))) (g : F ⟶ G),
      Epi g → Function.Surjective (g.hom.app (op V)))
    (U : SimplicialObject (Over ((Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange f).obj V)))
    (haff : ∀ n : ℕ, IsAffine (U _⦋n⦌).left.left)
    (hweak : ∀ (n : ℕ) (F G : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (Type (u + 1))) (f : F ⟶ G),
      Epi f → Function.Surjective (f.hom.app (op (U _⦋n⦌).left)))
    (hzero : Epi ((Scheme.ProEt.topology X).yoneda.map (U _⦋0⦌).hom))
    (hone : ∃ c : Fan (fun _ : Fin 2 ↦ U _⦋0⦌), Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧
      ∃ μ : U _⦋1⦌ ⟶ c.pt,
        (∀ i : Fin 2, μ ≫ c.proj i = U.δ i) ∧
        Epi ((Scheme.ProEt.topology X).yoneda.map μ.left))
    (hhigher : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ∃ c : Cone (SimplicialObject.matchingBoundaryIndex U n).multicospan,
        Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧ ∃ μ : U _⦋n + 2⦌ ⟶ c.pt,
          (∀ i : Fin (n + 3), μ ≫ c.π.app (WalkingMulticospan.left i) = U.δ i) ∧
          Epi ((Scheme.ProEt.topology X).yoneda.map μ.left)) :
    let A := Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj Λ X)
    let ev := Mod.forget (condensedRingObj Λ Y) ⋙
      (sheafSections (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op V)
    let T := (Mod.forget (condensedRingObj Λ X)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
      Scheme.ProEt.abelianHypercoverTotal X ((Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange f).obj V) U
    Nonempty ((CochainComplex.Plus.ι A ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙
      (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ f).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙
        DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q ⋙ ev) ≅
      (CochainComplex.Plus.ι A ⋙ T ⋙
        HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (.up ℤ) q))
